# CAPITAL-AI Chat Instructions

**Start with [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** — the repository's sole authorizing engineering and governance policy (`SOLO_MAINTAINER_FLOW@1`).

For implementation or review work, select and read the applicable engineering skills from `.agents/skills/registry.json`. For architecture consulting, recommendation, current best practices or trade-off analysis, select the matching advisory skills. For mixed tasks load both; for cross-domain tasks load all relevant domain skills in the same chat. Five optional domain chat agents are located under `.github/agents/`.

Verify changing facts using authoritative dated sources and the exact repository/runtime state. Do not imply continuously updated knowledge or tools/permissions unavailable in the chat. These instructions add no gates, approvers, runtime capabilities or authority beyond root `AGENTS.md`.
